title: Har biri va hammasi: each / all the
why: Uy haqida gapirganda «har bir xonada … bor» va «hamma xonada … bor» deyish kerak bo'ladi. Ma'no yaqin, lekin fe'l shakli boshqa — va xato shu yerda chiqadi.

points.text: each — har biri alohida, shuning uchun ot birlikda va fe'l ham birlikda: Each room has got a TV.

examples.en: Each room has got a TV.
Each flat has got a kitchen.

points.text: all the — hammasi birga, ot ko'plikda va fe'l ham ko'plikda: All the rooms have got a TV.

examples.en: All the rooms have got a TV.
All the flats have got a kitchen.

points.text: each + ot birlikda, all + the + ot ko'plikda. Faqat fe'l shakli farq qiladi — shuning uchun mashqda fe'lga qaraladi.

examples.en: Each student has got a book.
All the students have got books.

points.text: each of the … deb ham aytiladi, u ham birlik fe'l oladi: Each of the rooms has got a balcony. Every of degan shakl yo'q.

examples.en: Each of the rooms has got a balcony.

points.text: all the oldida of kerak emas: all the rooms. «All of rooms» xato — of dan keyin the bo'lishi shart: all of the rooms.

examples.en: All of the rooms are clean.

common_errors.wrong: Each rooms have got a TV.
common_errors.right: Each room has got a TV.
common_errors.why: each dan keyin ot birlikda va fe'l ham birlikda keladi.

common_errors.wrong: All the room has got a TV.
common_errors.right: All the rooms have got a TV.
common_errors.why: all the dan keyin ot ko'plikda va fe'l ham ko'plikda.

common_errors.right: All of the rooms are clean.
common_errors.why: of dan keyin the tushib qolmasligi kerak.

common_errors.wrong: Every of the flats has got a lift.
common_errors.right: Each of the flats has got a lift.
common_errors.why: of bilan faqat each ishlatiladi, every of degan shakl yo'q.

common_errors.wrong: Each of the rooms have got a bathroom.
common_errors.right: Each of the rooms has got a bathroom.
common_errors.why: Ko'plik ot kelgani bilan each birlik fe'l oladi: has got.

items.focus: each / all the ni to'g'ri qo'yish
each ↔ all the ga o'tkazish va fe'lni o'zgartirish
«Each rooms have», «All the room has», «all of rooms» xatolarini topish
o'zbekchadan tarjima: «Har bir xonada televizor bor»

final.task: Uyingizni tasvirlab yozing: nechta xona, har birida nima bor. each va all the ni ikki martadan ishlating.

skill_task.task: Ijaraga beradigan kvartirangizni baland ovozda tasvirlang: xonalar va mebel. each va all the ni aralashtirib ishlating.
